branch_decision_evidence.m3_to_m4_single_effect_and_after_errors: M4 improves every code's common-probe single after-MSE/effect skill; single-retention damage is not supported.
branch_decision_evidence.representation: Direct-context fitting improves held-out query prediction, so total representation failure is not supported; encoder/direct-context residual error means representation is not proven solved.
branch_decision_evidence.composition: M4 true-code query MSE improves over M3 on ordered pairs, so composition fine-tuning is helping, though held-out identification remains weak.

branch_decision_evidence.scope: Implement and validate paired functional-effect M3 objective first; do not claim a validated repair until the after-only/effect ablation passes validation gates.
